prefs.notes: SharedPreferences 'godhand_settings' (SettingsRepository). Index-valued ints, clamped on read. Renderer/resolution/aspect/fps/frameskip are passed to native code when the game surface is created; resolution, aspect, frameskip and audio also apply live via NativeBridge from the in-game dialog. Custom touch button layout is stored in the same file. Force-stop before editing.
